title: I love football and roguelites, so I made a game that mixes both
author: tom109283
selftext:
I've always been a **football** fan and a **roguelite** addict, and I never found a game that mixed both the way I wanted. So I made one.

You **pick a starter**, **choose your road** through a branching map and **build your team** along the way. Players from the same club or country link up and get stronger together, each one brings a playing style (pacey, dribbler, poacher, leader…) that boosts the whole squad, and the humble journeymen you recruit can **evolve into the stars** they share a club or a nation with.

There are **370 players to collect**, **4 competitions to win**, a **daily Cup**, and a **duel mode** I play with my friends.

If you're into football, roguelites, or both, I'd love for you to give it a try. It's free, plays in your browser and works great on mobile:

[https://poke-foot-like.vercel.app](https://poke-foot-like.vercel.app)



Made with Claude Code. Any feedback is welcome!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/tom109283 please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: anti_vill1an
comments.body:
Looks good, although I'm not sure if you'd get into trouble with copyrighted player names?

Not hating or anything...just curious?

replies.author: tom109283
replies.body: Fair question, no offense taken! Yes, it's a risk: player names and image rights, plus competition names that are trademarks. This is just a fun side project for me, it's free, and I don't expect it to blow up. If it ever does, I've kept all the real names in one place so I can switch to made-up players and competitions quickly. It would just be a bit less fun to play 😄
